fields.flaw: The asserted identity f ∘ (g ⊕ h) = (f ⊕ g) ∘ (f ⊕ h) for additive endomorphisms is false.
fields.problem:
Title: Endomorphism Ring of Abelian Group is Ring with Unity

Let $\struct {G, +}$ be an [[Definition:Abelian Group|abelian group]].

Let $\struct {\map {\mathrm {End} } G, \oplus, \circ}$ be its [[Definition:Endomorphism Ring of Abelian Group|endomorphism ring]].

Then $\struct {\map {\mathrm {End} } G, \oplus, \circ}$ is a [[Definition:Ring with Unity|ring]] with [[Definition:Unity of Ring|unity]] $I_G$, where:
:$I_G$ is the [[Definition:Identity Mapping|identity mapping]] on $G$
:$\oplus$ is the [[Definition:Pointwise Operation|pointwise operation on $\map {\mathrm {End} } G$ induced by $+$]].
fields.source_context:
0075 | From [[Structure Induced by Associative Operation is Associative]] we have that:
0076 | :$\paren {f \circ g} \circ h = f \circ \paren {g \circ h}$
0077 | 
0078 | So we have:
0079 | :$\forall f, g, h \in \map {\mathrm {End} } G: \paren{f \circ g} \circ h = f \circ \paren{g \circ h}$
0080 | 
0081 | So $\circ$ is [[Definition:Associative Operation|associative]] on $\map {\mathrm {End} } G$:
0082 | {{qed|lemma}}
0083 | 
0084 | === {{Ring-axiom|D|nolink}} ===
0085 | 
0086 | By [[Composition of Mappings is Left Distributive over Homomorphism of Pointwise Operation]]:
0087 | :$f \circ \paren {g \oplus h} = \paren {f \oplus g} \circ \paren {f \oplus h}$
0088 | 
0089 | By [[Composition of Mappings is Right Distributive over Pointwise Operation]]:
0090 | :$\paren {g \oplus h} \circ f= \paren {g \oplus f} \circ \paren {h \oplus f}$
0091 | 
0092 | So it follows from definition of [[Definition:Distributive Operation|distributive]] that [[Definition:Composition of Mappings|composition of mappings]] is [[Definition:Distributive Operation|distributive]] over [[Definition:Homomorphism (Abstract Algebra)|homomorphism]] of the [[Definition:Pointwise Operation|pointwise operation]] $\oplus$.
0093 | 
0094 | As $f, g, h$ are [[Definition:Homomorphism (Abstract Algebra)|endomorphisms]], it follows that [[Definition:Composition of Mappings|composition of mappings]] is [[Definition:Distributive Operation|distributive]] over [[Definition:Homomorphism (Abstract Algebra)|endomorphism]] of $\oplus$.
0095 | 
0096 | {{qed|lemma}}
0097 | 
0098 | Hence $\struct {\map {\mathrm {End} } G, \oplus, \circ}$ is a [[Definition:Ring with Unity|ring]] with [[Definition:Unity of Ring|unity]] $I_G$.
0099 | {{qed}}
fields.witness: Interpret ⊕ as pointwise addition. Let A = ZMod 2 and f,g,h : A →+ A be f=0, g=id, h=id. All are additive endomorphisms. At x=1: (g⊕h)(1)=1+1=0, so [f∘(g⊕h)](1)=0. But (f⊕h)(1)=1 and (f⊕g)(1)=1, so [(f⊕g)∘(f⊕h)](1)=1. Thus the maps differ.
